method: Every repository freshly cloned from GitHub on 2026-11-23 (E:/repos, partial clones). Refs pinned below. Tests listed under evidence were re-run in this audit unless marked 'read only'. Statuses follow docs/CROSS-PROJECT-INTEGRATION.md: reference | candidate | imported | validated | rejected. Nothing in this manifest is 'imported' or 'validated' for the arcade yet.

consumer.stack: plain browser JS + canvas, fixed-step loop (1/120 s), pixel units, unseeded Math.random

entries.what: Seeded mulberry32 PRNG with range() and normal(); string seeds hashed (FNV-1a).
entries.evidence: Used by every gridiron replay; determinism covered by test/autonomous-results.mjs (passes, re-run).
entries.arcade_use: Hockey R1 'seed all randomness': replace the 4 Math.random calls in src/hockey.js. Smallest, highest-value reuse.
entries.boundary: MIT. Copy with provenance header; no runtime dependency on gridiron.

entries.what: Constrained basketball action library: the caller picks an action by name and a 0..1 time and never sets joints; runtime enforces feet on floor, elbow/knee limits, palm-to-ball at named contact time. v1 actions: stance, dribble, swipe (more ball actions named: crossover, fadeaway, floater, catch, shot, block). CMU 124_05 jump shot and 15_12 pass reference poses.
entries.evidence: Re-run 2026-11-23: library.test.mjs, actions.test.mjs, skeleton.test.mjs, sprite.test.mjs all pass.
entries.arcade_use: Basketball micro-slice and the action.v1 contract: this is the same stack as the arcade (browser JS) and already matches 'action owns declared joints and contact timing'. Prefer it over porting The U's GDScript for R0-R2.
entries.boundary: Unmerged: 94 commits ahead of gridiron main, 3 behind. CMU refs: CMU places no restrictions. Must pass the arcade's own rendered-mesh review before promotion.

entries.what: Two-body contact, foot lock, two-bone IK, pose blending, stride generation, tackle simulation with fall directions, and validators that measure them.
entries.evidence: Re-run 2026-11-23: validate-locomotion 'all gaits under 10 cm per plant' (carry 2.5-3.2 cm, backpedal 7.7-8.5 cm, shuffle 4.2-5.2 cm). validate-tackles: penetration median 0.018 m (max 0.133), foot slide median 0.211 m (p90 0.382, max 0.599), root speed max 12.83 m/s, falls back 66/105, L 40/63, R 44/72, fwd 5/6.
entries.arcade_use: Wrestling paired-actor contact and football tackle slices; the validators are the measurement half of the arcade 'Motion' gate. Tackle foot slide (0.2-0.6 m) and 12.8 m/s peak root speed are open defects to carry, not adopt.
entries.boundary: Unmerged branch. Visual acceptance on the rendered mesh still required.

entries.what: LP owns game state and sampled outcomes; Gridiron renders outcome-anchored physics. Typed event families; a score never teleports; unknown kinds fail.
entries.evidence: Re-run: test/validate.mjs --strict passes. test/prototype.mjs FAILS on main (TypeError: book.pregame_2026_comparison undefined). test:week7 mutation audit FAILS: 10 mutations survive (kickoff/safety/blocked-punt spot rules).
entries.arcade_use: Pattern for the arcade replay log and 'possession changes only on a declared event'. Not football gameplay: the replay track is anchored to sampled outcomes, so it is not a movement model.
entries.boundary: Two failing suites on main must be reported, not inherited silently.

entries.what: Autonomous inside-zone simulation with perception, passing, rules, kneel/spike, results reconciliation.
entries.evidence: Re-run: npm run test:autonomous passes. Read only: docs/AUTONOMOUS-STAGE-ONE-REPORT-2026-10-25.md: 1.0 s mean position error 2.092 m vs constant-velocity baseline 0.992 m. It loses to the trivial baseline.
entries.arcade_use: Do not adopt its movement (fails the spec's own baseline rule). Reuse the shape: one whistle per play, event log that reconciles to the result, frame-by-frame determinism tests.

entries.what: Role-based movement priors vs constant acceleration on 1,859 plays.
entries.evidence: Read only: 1 s mean error constant acceleration 1.071 m, league-role prior 0.792 m, role+team 0.789 m. Development set, not a holdout.
entries.arcade_use: Football AI spacing: role priors beat physics-free baselines; team identity adds almost nothing at 1 s.

entries.arcade_use: Football AI play-calling tendencies, with the RedZone transcript tendencies (rs.redzone-tendencies) as hypotheses to check against it.
entries.boundary: Large data; reference by commit, do not copy.

entries.evidence: Re-run on fresh dev with --fixed-fps 60: see test_results in docs/REUSE-AUDIT-2026-11-23.md.

entries.what: Independent structural NHL rules audit for simulated games: center faceoff after a goal, restart locations, penalty restart, shift boundaries at faceoffs, shootout early decision.
entries.evidence: Re-run 2026-11-23: 18 tests, 14 pass, 4 error (FileNotFoundError: /root/lp-data/nhl-fullframe-event-audit-2026-10-21/manifests/... on another machine).
entries.arcade_use: Hockey R1 invariant tests: port the faceoff-after-goal and restart rules to JS checks over the arcade event log. Arcade rules are a subset (no penalties/offside yet), so take only the rules the slice implements.
entries.boundary: Python; port, don't depend. The 4 fixture tests need the LP data box.

entries.what: Event-level NHL game generator with team, player, goalie and shift models.
entries.evidence: Read only: on 1,100 matched 2021 games the simple team-rate reference beat every v0.2b candidate on goal CRPS, final-score energy, winner Brier and SOG CRPS; candidates also had 52-68 penalty-expiration and 35-53 penalized-player-on-ice state failures. Report says: do not adopt.
entries.arcade_use: Tune arcade AI to team-level shot and goal rates, not player models. The two state-failure classes are exactly what the arcade's penalty work must test for.
entries.boundary: Unmerged research branch (21 ahead of dev).

entries.what: Big Data Cup 2026 (10 anonymized games, 959,754 tracking frames, puck in every frame): what follows a shot.
entries.evidence: Read only: 1,190 attempts (58 goals); 508 on net, 290 blocked, 334 missed; puck recovered within 3 s after 621 (295 shooting team, 326 opponent); follow-up shot within 5 s after 174.
entries.arcade_use: Concrete targets for arcade puck recovery and rebounds (about half of shots are recovered within 3 s, split nearly evenly; about 15% produce a follow-up shot within 5 s). The tracking data is also the only real skater/puck speed source found for hockey motion benchmarks.
entries.boundary: Data (674 MB) is not in git; check Big Data Cup terms before any derived asset ships.

entries.what: Pair-level multi-agent skater movement diagnostics on 10 games.
entries.evidence: Read only: descriptive structure only; 'No accuracy, skill, or profit claim'; cross-game identity untestable on the source.
entries.arcade_use: None at runtime. Its finding (pair errors persist; one shrink factor does not explain spacing) is a warning for hockey AI spacing claims.

entries.evidence: Read only. Unmerged: 42 ahead of LP dev.
